continuity: Taekyung's party has entered the Sichuan Tang Clan's fortified compound, and the Family Head has permitted Taekyung's group to enter the Family Head's Hall after receiving Mae Jonghak's letter.
The Sichuan Tang Clan is in unexplained heightened defensive readiness, with crossbows, armed personnel, weapon preparation, and poison mist throughout the compound.

plot: Jin Taekyung's party reaches the fortified Sichuan Tang Clan, whose gate guards admit them only after Taekyung presents a handwritten letter from Mae Jonghak, the Sword Saint.

Inside the Tang Clan, the party finds craftsmen and martial artists preparing weapons amid unexplained wartime tension and poison mist. Mungyeong is escorted away to seek a medicinal prescription, while Taekyung, Gung Gibang, Hyuk Mujin, and Cheongpung surrender their weapons, undergo a search, and enter the Family Head's Hall after being summoned inside.
translation_decisions: Render 당가타 as Tang Family Hill and 당가 as Tang Family when the source distinguishes it from 사천당문, rendered Sichuan Tang Clan.
Retain Oseong and Haneum as the paired historical names in Taekyung's joke and explain the pairing in a footnote.
Render 의생님 as Medical Apprentice and 약방문 as prescription.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung's party has reached and entered the Sichuan Tang Clan's fortified compound after the Family Head granted permission based on Mae Jonghak's handwritten letter.
Taekyung, Gung Gibang, Hyuk Mujin, and Cheongpung are inside the Sichuan Tang Clan's Family Head's Hall after surrendering their weapons and undergoing a search.
The Sichuan Tang Clan is in unexplained heightened defensive readiness, with crossbows, armed personnel, weapon preparation, and poison mist present throughout the compound.
Mungyeong has been escorted away to seek a medicinal prescription from the Sichuan Tang Clan.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious on the party's pack frame and is steadily weakening; True Qi Guidance can only slow the decline.
The Divine Physician, whose identity remains unknown, is the party's only known hope for treating Jeok Cheongang and is believed to be somewhere in Sichuan.
Taekyung possesses the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng.
Mungyeong is a capable, compassionate medical apprentice accompanying Taekyung's party while seeking treatment for Jeok Cheongang.
Ju Hwaran remains the Yongbong Escort Bureau's Young Bureau Head and is investigating escort captains who aided Heo Jun's scheme.
Song Ilseom will remain for one month to help Ju Hwaran purge the bureau's traitors, then seek an elixir for Ju Hogun in Xianyang.
The Zhongnan Sect's other conspirators and the organizers behind the broader scheme remain unidentified.
The identity of the person who sought the Guangdong Chen Family's Peak martial arts and the fate of the family's other members remain unresolved.
open_questions: What caused the Sichuan Tang Clan's emergency preparations, and will the Family Head cooperate with Taekyung's party?
Can the Divine Physician treat Jeok Cheongang before his remaining window closes?
What punishment will Yangtze River Channel League headquarters impose on Hwang Tae-gu, and can his connections still affect his fate?
Which other Yongbong Escort Bureau members collaborated with Heo Jun, and how will the Zhongnan Sect's leaders and the wider organizers respond?
Who sought the Guangdong Chen Family's Peak martial arts, and what happened to the other members of the family?
temporary_decisions: Render 선화아 as Ship-Fire Boy and retain Mu Song for 무송.
Render 사천당문 as Sichuan Tang Clan and 당가 as Tang Family when the source distinguishes the forms.
Render 공자님 as Young Master when Mungyeong addresses Taekyung.
Render 노야 as Old Master in Taekyung's private address for Jeok Cheongang.
